title: planmemreplay
description: MEG recordings from a study of replay during planning and memory maintenance, associated with the paper 'Distinct replay signatures for planning and memory maintenance'. The dataset includes MEG data with a trigger channel for event marking, plus event files with onsets provided for completeness. Visual event timing has an estimated projector delay of about 20 ms, measured with a photodiode.
methods_description: MEG files contain a trigger channel for event marking and timing. Separate event files are provided for completeness only, and triggers should be used for analysis onsets. The delay between trigger and visual onset from the projector is about 20 ms, as estimated with a photodiode.
